text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Verxina apparently got a high score on a 
difficult written exam. I offered her some 
words of praise, but...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, yes! What is it?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, sorry. I've always been like 
this... Once I finish a task, my brain 
just stops working...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps as a rebound from putting 
everything into studying, Verxina seemed 
completely burned out. She might stay 
spaced out for a while.
